productPolicy.firstQualifyingCoreGi: Included once with a student's first qualifying Core Culture enrollment; continuation products do not add another gi.

flexibleAccess.localFirstTimer: Start with the Free First Visit and choose Core Culture when building a regular local training rhythm.
flexibleAccess.inClassCoaching: All students receive appropriate coaching, safety management, and partner guidance while in class.
flexibleAccess.bookingRule: Request an appropriate class with available space and suitable partner fit; capacity and placement still control.

productPolicy.renewal: At the end of a term, review what is working, what comes next, and which schedule or product fits. Renewal is a choice; there is no automatic escalation.

renewedCoreCulture.recurringHomeClassReservation: Reviewed and confirmed for the next term
renewedCoreCulture.rescheduling: Open-seat rescheduling under current capacity and suitable-partner rules
renewedCoreCulture.gi: No additional gi by virtue of renewal

eliteConcierge.name: Elite Concierge
eliteConcierge.eligibility: Adults continuing after a Core Culture term; application and schedule review required
eliteConcierge.guarantee: Excluded from the 30-Day Training Fit Guarantee
eliteConcierge.gi: No additional gi; the first qualifying Core Culture gi carries forward
